blocker_fixes.change: Operational isotonic input is WM P(better), never mean gain or p_best. Require identity-linked paired-sample probability evidence embedded in the candidate before verification, with its own digest and the existing plan/spec/receipt hash chain. Typed inference requires consuming candidate/snapshot/start identity and planner contract. Scalar gains and scalar probabilities are rejected. Legacy gains are available only through a diagnostic that cannot emit a planner artifact.

GateContract binds full horizon, objective, MAPPO-only baseline and producer-attested policy state hash. Evidence must meet mppi_search.final_horizon(duration_s), fit the controlled episode, and exactly match the realised window and consuming planner. Candidate specs must show no committed moves in the realised policy baseline. Fit, artifact load and prediction each refuse incompatible contracts; the registered horizon is never shortened.

Only linked first_seed/seed2 all-candidate panels enter operational fitting and validation. Outcome-selected all8 extra links are recorded as excluded provenance without opening them. Preflight excludes their hashes even when selected receipts are also passed directly, independent of argument order. Standalone receipts without panel-selection proof cannot fit a gate. Conflicting primary/selected provenance is refused.
blocker_fixes.real_selection_probe: The real confirm_all8 function with a deterministic CPU SeedPlant verifies two candidates on seeds 1/2 and selects only the winner for four extras. Loading with/without those real extra links yields the same four primary rows and 0.50 observed win rate. Direct duplicate inputs cannot restore the selected rows; extra-only inputs cannot produce an operational model.

source_contract.evidence_location: plan.wm_probability_evidence; must exist before verification, never retrofitted into old receipts
source_contract.optional_samples: List of [unique_sample_id, MAPPO-only J, candidate J] on paired belief/noise draws. When present, count/identities/cost finiteness and p_better == fraction(baseline J > candidate J) are checked. Recorded P(better) without samples still requires paired=true and multiple-sample provenance.
source_contract.provenance_limit: Baseline/objective/policy identity in the WM evidence is a producer attestation bound to the verifier snapshot identity, not reconstructed by opening snapshots, model weights or truth files. Candidate specs separately prove the realised reference has no committed moves.
source_contract.realised_label: Same-receipt J_policy_veh_s - J_candidates_veh_s[i] > 0; ties/losses are non-wins
source_contract.population: all-candidates-before-outcome-selection/v1; first/second panels only; all graded candidates from accepted and rejected WM decisions
source_contract.unusable_rows: Failed/ungraded branches and missing explicit own-policy gain diagnostics are counted and not imputed. Missing/mismatched probability or horizon evidence refuses operational fitting; it is not silently repaired or dropped to create a favourable model.
source_contract.split: Deterministic development split by episode.world.seed; all CRN replicas/candidates/updates/arms for an original world remain together
source_contract.data_access: Explicit local JSON receipts and linked candidate specs only; lexical/resolved path guards, explicit development allowlist, development-role check and inherited excluded evaluation seed ranges

api.reliability / reliability_svg: Equal-width reliability metrics and standalone validation SVG
